cohort: Women with term singleton births, no previous caesarean delivery and planned vaginal delivery in Denmark
finding: Epidural analgesia and augmentation of labour with oxytocin were associated with increased risk of complete uterine rupture in multiparous women.
mod_finding: This study found that while uterine rupture is rare, it is associated with epidural analgesia and labor augmentation with oxytocin in multiparous women.
